mistakes.text: The terminal was empty; even though, she felt watched.
mistakes.normalized: the terminal was empty even though she felt watched
mistakes.kind: even though instead of even so
mistakes.feedback_sk: „Even though“ a „even if“ uvádzajú vedľajšiu vetu; samostatne za bodkočiarkou patrí „even so“.
mistakes.feedback_cz: „Even though“ a „even if“ uvádějí vedlejší větu; samostatně za středníkem patří „even so“.
mistakes.feedback_en: “Even though” and “even if” start a clause; alone after a semicolon use “even so”.

mistakes.text: The terminal was empty; even if, she felt watched.
mistakes.normalized: the terminal was empty even if she felt watched
mistakes.kind: even though instead of even so
mistakes.feedback_sk: „Even though“ a „even if“ uvádzajú vedľajšiu vetu; samostatne za bodkočiarkou patrí „even so“.
mistakes.feedback_cz: „Even though“ a „even if“ uvádějí vedlejší větu; samostatně za středníkem patří „even so“.
mistakes.feedback_en: “Even though” and “even if” start a clause; alone after a semicolon use “even so”.

mistakes.text: The terminal was empty; although, she felt watched.
mistakes.normalized: the terminal was empty although she felt watched
mistakes.feedback_sk: „Although“ nemôže stáť samo za bodkočiarkou; význam „aj tak“ má „even so“.
mistakes.feedback_cz: „Although“ nemůže stát samo za středníkem; význam „přesto“ má „even so“.
mistakes.feedback_en: “Although” can't stand alone after a semicolon; for “all the same” use “even so”.

mistakes.text: The terminal was empty; however, she felt watched.
mistakes.normalized: the terminal was empty however she felt watched
mistakes.feedback_sk: „However“ vyjadrí len kontrast; „aj tak“ presnejšie vystihuje „even so“.
mistakes.feedback_cz: „However“ vyjádří jen kontrast; „přesto“ přesněji vystihuje „even so“.
mistakes.feedback_en: “However” only contrasts; “even so” better keeps the meaning “in spite of that”.

mistakes.text: The terminal was deserted; however, she felt watched.
mistakes.normalized: the terminal was deserted however she felt watched
mistakes.feedback_sk: „However“ vyjadrí len kontrast; „aj tak“ presnejšie vystihuje „even so“.
mistakes.feedback_cz: „However“ vyjádří jen kontrast; „přesto“ přesněji vystihuje „even so“.
mistakes.feedback_en: “However” only contrasts; “even so” better keeps the meaning “in spite of that”.

mistakes.text: The terminal was empty, but she felt watched.
mistakes.normalized: the terminal was empty but she felt watched
mistakes.feedback_sk: „But“ je bežné; na úrovni B2 sa tu precvičuje spojka „even so“.
mistakes.feedback_cz: „But“ je běžné; na úrovni B2 se tu procvičuje spojka „even so“.
mistakes.feedback_en: Here practise the linker “even so” instead of the simple “but”.

mistakes.text: The terminal was deserted, but she felt watched.
mistakes.normalized: the terminal was deserted but she felt watched

mistakes.text: The terminal was empty; even so, she felt watching.
mistakes.normalized: the terminal was empty even so she felt watching
mistakes.feedback_sk: „Felt watching“ znamená, že sleduje ona. Pocit, že ju niekto sleduje, je „felt watched“.
mistakes.feedback_cz: „Felt watching“ znamená, že sleduje ona. Pocit, že ji někdo sleduje, je „felt watched“.
mistakes.feedback_en: “Felt watching” means she is the one watching; being observed is “felt watched”.
